subject: Re: Lumos Health billing terms — net terms, VAT, and credit guardrails
messages:
From: Eliza Morris <eliza.morris@lumoshealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lumos Health Finance <finance@lumoshealth.com>
Date: 2027-07-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Net60 and VAT handling for pilot PO

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the walkthrough on Tuesday — the product looked promising for our clinician-facing pilot. Our procurement team has raised two items before we can route the PO:

1) Payment terms: Lumos typically requests Net60 for pilot engagements. Is Redwood able to accept Net60 for the initial 3-month pilot?
2) VAT / invoicing entity: We need clarity on which Redwood legal entity will issue invoices to our EU subsidiary and whether VAT will be charged or reverse-charged.

Attached is our draft PO (lumos_po_3421.pdf). Please confirm whether Net60 is acceptable or if you need shorter terms. Also advise any documentation (VAT certificate, invoice examples) we should provide to speed approvals.

We'd like to close this week if possible.

Best regards,
Eliza Morris
Director of Finance — Lumos Health

Attachments: lumos_po_3421.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eliza Morris <eliza.morris@lumoshealth.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-07-13T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Net60 and VAT handling for pilot PO

Hi Eliza — thanks for the PO and the quick timeline. Short answer: we can be flexible, but we need to balance credit exposure and unit economics for the pilot. Options we can offer: 

- Conditional Net45 (default): Redwood issues monthly invoices, payment due Net45. We cap total outstanding at EUR 150k during the pilot (credit corridor).
- Net60 (customer ask): accept Net60 if Lumos provides a corporate guarantee or a pre-funded deposit equal to one month of expected consumption (we can estimate).
- Net30 with 1% early-pay discount if paid within 15 days (incentivizes quicker settlement).

On VAT: Redwood will invoice from our EU entity (Redwood Inference EU GmbH) and will typically charge VAT unless you provide a valid reverse-charge VAT certificate for your Lumos EU entity. If you share the VAT registration (certificate), we can issue zero-rated invoices with reverse charge. Olga, can you flag any additional compliance docs we need?

I've attached our SOW and a proposed payment schedule example to make the credit math transparent.

Let me know which of the above your team prefers and whether the PO needs edits — happy to jump on a call.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW_Redwood_v3.pdf (application/pdf), proposed_payment_schedule.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eliza Morris <eliza.morris@lumoshealth.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-07-13T14:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Net60 and VAT handling for pilot PO

Hi Eliza,

Quick note from finance / tax: if Lumos will be reverse-charging VAT we need:
- Copy of Lumos EU VAT registration (PDF)
- Billing address and legal entity name that matches the VAT cert

If you cannot provide those, Redwood will invoice from our EU entity and will apply local VAT. Also: for Net60 we would need either:
- a) a prepayment equal to 25% of the first-month estimate, or
- b) a signed credit addendum (we can draft) plus a purchase order with explicit payment triggers and a EUR 150k credit cap for the pilot.

Markus — I'm flexible on Net45 as default. We should include a clause for consumption caps and an automatic hold at 180k exposure. Marissa, please prepare a short addendum template we can attach to the SOW.

Thanks,
Olga
VP, Finance — Redwood Inference
From: Eliza Morris <eliza.morris@lumoshealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lumos Health Finance <finance@lumoshealth.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-07-14T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Net60 and VAT handling for pilot PO

Markus / Olga — thanks for the clear options. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) VAT: Lumos EU will provide the VAT registration. Attaching the cert now.
2) Payment terms: our procurement policy prefers Net60 for pilots to preserve cash runway. We cannot provide a corporate guarantee. However, Lumos can accept a pre-funded deposit equal to one month of expected spend. Would Redwood accept Net60 conditioned on a one-month prepay?
3) Early-pay incentive: we like the idea of a 1% discount for 15-day settlement, but we can't rely on it as a guaranteed practice.

Attaching the VAT cert we discussed. If Net60 + one-month prepay is acceptable, we can route the PO today.

Best,
Eliza

Attachments: Lumos_VAT_certificate.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eliza Morris <eliza.morris@lumoshealth.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-07-15T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Net60 and VAT handling for pilot PO

Eliza — thanks for the swift turnaround and for sharing the VAT certificate. That's perfect for reverse-charge.

We can accept Net60 on the following commitments (compromise path):
- Lumos provides a one-month prepayment at contract start (applied against invoices in month 1).
- Redwood will invoice Net60 thereafter.
- Credit cap during pilot set at EUR 175,000; automatic hold/escrow trigger at EUR 190,000.
- We will include a 1% early-pay discount if payment is posted within 15 days (optional).
- We will issue invoices from Redwood Inference EU GmbH and mark them as reverse-charge (no VAT applied) since you provided the VAT cert.

Marissa will attach the short credit addendum and an edited PO/SOW reflecting the prepayment. If that looks good, once Lumos returns a countersigned PO we can generate the DocuSign for the SOW and kickoff on Monday.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if you want to walk through the payment schedule.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
